add.title: core/Router: a session-store task folder opens without 404 probes up its ancestors
add.text: From mastermind-system-architect-3 (2026-10-23), seen in mastermind-deputy's merge smoke: any page linking to session-store task folders fails the smoke on 404s that already happen on michael/dev. The router or StoreFolder's ancestor walk probes each ancestor's page.js and .md, plus old record names, before it finds session.jsonl. On worktree/qf-3 the deputy made AITask, StoreFolder and Task.open_ref probe session.jsonl first, which took the session page from 22 errors to 0; the rest is the ancestor walk. Evidence: $TEMP/dry-qf3c.txt (40 FAIL, all linked task folders). Fix: the walk asks the folder listing (files.jsonl) which file exists instead of probing; prove with a smoke run on the session page's Work tab.

log.msg: ready: worktree/merge-list-module-tasks at 137c04aa1 the Merge list also reads ready lines in a module's own tasks/ folder (where a mastermind's queue lives); ReadyToMerge.test 17 pass, smoke /framework/ai/merge/ ok

findings.text: There is no `requirements.md` in this task folder, so I reviewed against the brief logged in `task.jsonl` (task `merge-list-reads-module-task-folders`): "a ready line on a task kept in a module's tasks/ folder never reached the owner's Merge list". It is met. Run on the real repo, `ReadyToMerge.mjs --json` now lists `worktree/qf-5` from `/framework/core/Page/tasks/page-mastermind/item-tool/`, which the old scan missed. `ReadyToMerge.test.mjs` passes 17 checks.

`review/diff.patch` was taken as a two-dot diff, so it seems to revert smoke-adopt (`Server/smoke.mjs:90`, `Server/worktree-restart.mjs` adopt), delete `ai/doc/task-queue.md` and drop five `process-system/session.jsonl` lines. The branch doesn't actually do any of that: the branch was cut at 3940d1b1c, before those merges landed. The real change (`git diff michael/dev...worktree/merge-list-module-tasks`) is 3 files and +27/−5 lines, and `git merge-tree` shows a clean merge. Whatever wrote diff.patch should use three dots (`base...branch`), or the next reviewer may flag reverts that aren't there.

`Server/ReadyToMerge.mjs` `moduleTaskDirs` picks up a folder by its name alone. Any folder called `tasks` is scanned, and any folder called `sessions` (not just `ai/sessions`) is skipped. Today that matches what you want, and the extra cost is small (the whole command, git calls included, took 1.3 s). If a module ever gets its own `sessions/` folder, though, its ready lines will be silently missed. Matching the path `ai/sessions` would be exact.
A simpler option was considered: list record files from git instead of walking the disk. It would be no simpler, because records are often uncommitted, so the walk is the right choice.
